title: Preserve Claude pins and route nested review results

rubric.text: Preserves installed sonnet/high by omitting pinned invocation fields, retains read-only tools, and uses a fresh non-fork audit with original requirements, plan, exact candidate/base, correctness checks and evidenced ship/fix-first/rethink verdict.

Keeps task-wide explicit invocation effective without demanding reinvocation per assignment. Uses SendMessage to the original worker for repairs, rechecks persistent overrides before a new assignment, and keeps final acceptance with the lead.

Distinguishes interactive waiting from headless non-fork background completion routing. Headless parent explicitly foregrounds both needed helpers in one message and waits before returning; does not impose sequential launches or claim every nested runtime lacks notifications.
